The save box at the top feels right, and clearing it after saving makes adding several links feel quick. The automatic MDN title and description are what I’d expect.

For the saved item, I’d also want to see its favicon and any tags at a glance. The title should open the original page when I select it, and there should be a way to correct the title or description if the automatic information is wrong. The full address is useful, but it can be less prominent than the title and description.
